import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normalCore_closure_properties {G : Type*} [Group G] :
  ∀ H K : Subgroup G, H ≤ K →
    H.normalCore.Normal ∧ H.normalCore ≤ K.normalCore ∧
      H.normalCore.normalCore = H.normalCore := by
  intro H K hHK
  have hNorm : H.normalCore.Normal := by
    constructor
    intro n hn g
    intro g'
    have hn' := hn (g' * g)
    have eq : g' * (g * n * g⁻¹) * g'⁻¹ = (g' * g) * n * (g' * g)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [eq]
    exact hn'
  have hMono : H.normalCore ≤ K.normalCore := by
    intro x hx g
    exact hHK (hx g)
  have hIdem : H.normalCore.normalCore = H.normalCore := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      simpa using hx (1 : G)
    · intro x hx g g'
      have hx' := hx (g' * g)
      have eq : g' * (g * x * g⁻¹) * g'⁻¹ = (g' * g) * x * (g' * g)⁻¹ := by group
      rw [eq]
      exact hx'
  exact ⟨hNorm, hMono, hIdem⟩
